notes: Whole pack: distractors repeatedly reuse unrelated meanings (e.g. tai nạn, tài khoản, kế toán viên for nouns; bỏ rơi, hấp thụ, chấp nhận for verbs). They offer little semantic discrimination. Best answers independently selected from the wording follow A-B-C-D repeatedly through Q50, making positions predictable.
Q3 (C): friend is more precisely người bạn / một người bạn. Bạn bè is a collective gloss; understandable, but it does not preserve the singular headword as well.

Q45 (A): Cuối tuần của bạn thế nào? is natural but does not explicitly retain the past-time reference in How was your weekend? Cuối tuần vừa rồi của bạn thế nào? would be clearer in an isolated translation question.
Q47 (C): red is labelled an adjective, so đỏ is the cleaner gloss; màu đỏ can be read as a noun phrase. C is still clearly the best answer.

Q50 (B): Mình khỏe, cảm ơn is appropriate as a greeting response. Without a conversational context, I am doing well can also concern how life or work is going; Mình vẫn ổn, cảm ơn is less narrowly about health.
